description: This source file defines the PersonAddress class, which models a person's address in the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It includes address fields, metadata, and methods for managing and comparing addresses within the system.

classes.name: PersonAddress
classes.description: Represents a person's address with multiple address fields, location data, and activity status, used within the OpenMRS medical record system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the address.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the address.

methods.name: isPreferred
methods.description: Deprecated. Checks if this address is preferred.

methods.name: getPreferred
methods.description: Returns whether the address is marked as preferred.

methods.name: setPreferred
methods.description: Sets whether the address is preferred.

methods.name: setPerson
methods.description: Associates this address with a Person.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if all address fields are blank or empty.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this address with another for ordering.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date for address validity.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for address validity.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date for address validity.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for address validity.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the address is currently active (not ended).

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Marks the address as inactive by setting an end date.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Marks the address as active by clearing the end date.
